description: Release proofs (docs/protocol.md section 9) with the verdict of each, for the two verifiers of this repository: the node (protocol/src/release_proofs.rs) and the secure program of the app (secure-program/secure-program.js). Both give `accepted` on every case. `release_proofs_text` is the JSON text of the proofs: a verifier parses it with its own reader of JSON, and a text that reader refuses is refused. `measurement` is the measurement the proofs are verified for, `trust` names what they are verified with, `release` is the release the statement names (for proofs that hold), and `rule` names the rule that refuses the others: V1 to V7 of section 9, or `form` for a value that is no release proofs (no JSON, no object with a text `statement` and an object `attestation`, or more than 32 arrays and objects inside one another). A trust of `trusts` holds the root certificate and the intermediate certificate of the certificate authority (`fulcio_root`, `fulcio_intermediate`: DER in base64url), the keys of the transparency logs (`log_keys`: the DER of each SubjectPublicKeyInfo in base64url), the issuer of the tokens, the repository with its identifier and the identifier of its owner, and the build workflows (`builders`: the path of each workflow file and its commit). The trust `source` has no values here: it is the constants of the verifier itself, the certificates of Sigstore, the key of Rekor and the build workflows of this repository. The file is written by protocol/vectors/release_proofs.py.
